capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Declare `"sources": [{ "type": "clock", "intervalMs": 1000 }]` when displaying live clocks or multi-timezone panels.
- Built-in expression function `tz('<zoneId>', '<format>')` and `tz('<zoneId>', '<format>', <offsetHours>)`:
  - Supported `<zoneId>`: IANA IDs (`"Asia/Shanghai"`, `"Asia/Tokyo"`, `"Europe/London"`, `"Europe/Berlin"`, `"America/New_York"`, `"America/Los_Angeles"`, `"Australia/Sydney"`, `"Asia/Singapore"`), `"UTC"`, `"local"`, or fixed offsets (`"UTC+8"`, `"UTC-5"`).
  - Supported `<format>`: standard .NET time patterns (`"HH:mm"`, `"HH:mm:ss"`, `"MM-dd HH:mm"`, `"ddd HH:mm"`, `"zzz"` for UTC offsets).
  - Optional `<offsetHours>` (default 0, supports halves like 2.5) shifts the reference instant forward — pair with a scrubber Slider bound to `state.scrubHours`.
- Semantic helpers (all DST-correct via `TimeZoneInfo`, zero reflection):
  - `tzDiffLabel('<zoneId>', <offsetHours>?)` → localized relative-diff + cross-day label (`"慢 7h · 同日"` / `"behind 7h · yesterday"`).
  - `tzWorkState('<zoneId>', '<workWindow>', <offsetHours>?)` → `"work"` / `"edge"` (07:00–start, end–22:00) / `"sleep"` (22:00–07:00).
  - `tzCity('<zoneId>')` → localized display name of 24 built-in business cities (13 locales).
- Exact `$clock.*` tokens: `${$clock.fullTime}`, `${$clock.seconds}`, `${$clock.utcTime}`, `${$clock.utcFullTime}`, `${$clock.utcDate}`, `${$clock.localOffset}`, `${$clock.unixSeconds}`, `${$clock.iso}`.

members.name: { "type": "rss", "url": "https://...", "targetCollection": "items" }
members.descriptionZh: 解析 RSS / Atom 订阅并自动提取 title, summary, link, pubDate
members.descriptionEn: Parses RSS/Atom feeds into title, summary, link, pubDate

members.name: { "type": "httpJson", "url": "...", "itemsPath": "$.data" }
members.descriptionZh: 请求 JSON 接口，通过 stateMap 提取单值或 itemsPath 映射列表
members.descriptionEn: Fetches JSON APIs with scalar stateMap or array itemsPath/fieldMap

members.name: { "type": "source.refresh", "targetId": "feed" }
members.descriptionZh: 立即手动刷新指定或全部数据源（支持 targetId / sourceId）
members.descriptionEn: Immediately refreshes a specific or all data sources (supports targetId / sourceId)

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- `rss` source auto-populates `targetCollection` (default `"items"`) with `${$item.title}`, `${$item.summary}`, `${$item.link}` (`${$item.url}`), `${$item.pubDate}`.
- `httpJson` source maps scalars via `"stateMap": { "price": "$.bitcoin.usd" }` and arrays via `"targetCollection": "items", "itemsPath": "$.stories", "fieldMap": { "title": "title", "url": "url" }`. Optional `"headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer ${$secrets.apiKey}" }`. Minimum `intervalMs` is `15000`.
- **Curated Keyless Public API & RSS Endpoints (Single Source of Truth — Prefer Over Unverified URLs)**:
  - CN Tech/News RSS (`type: "rss"`): SSPai (少数派) `"https://sspai.com/feed"`, ITHome (IT之家) `"https://www.ithome.com/rss/"`, GCores (机核) `"https://www.gcores.com/rss"`, Ruanyifeng Weekly (阮一峰周刊) `"https://www.ruanyifeng.com/blog/atom.xml"`.
  - CN Live JSON (`type: "httpJson"`): V2EX Hot `"https://www.v2ex.com/api/topics/hot.json"` (`itemsPath: "$"`, `fieldMap: { "title": "title", "url": "url", "replies": "replies", "node": "node.title" }`); Zhihu Daily `"https://news-at.zhihu.com/api/4/news/latest"` (`itemsPath: "$.stories"`, `fieldMap: { "title": "title", "url": "url", "hint": "hint" }`).
  - Global Tech & Dev Feeds: Hacker News Algolia Front Page `"https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?tags=front_page"` (`itemsPath: "$.hits"`, `fieldMap: { "title": "title", "url": "url", "points": "points", "comments": "num_comments", "author": "author" }`); HN RSS `"https://hnrss.org/frontpage"`; GitHub Releases `"https://api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<repo>/releases/latest"` (`stateMap: { "tag": "$.tag_name", "publishedAt": "$.published_at", "releaseUrl": "$.html_url" }`).
  - Global Weather, FX & Crypto JSON (`type: "httpJson"`): Open-Meteo `"https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=39.90&longitude=116.40&current=temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,wind_speed_10m,weather_code&timezone=auto"` (`stateMap: { "temp": "$.current.temperature_2m", "humidity": "$.current.relative_humidity_2m", "wind": "$.current.wind_speed_10m" }`; or prefer built-in `"type": "weather"` source); FX Rates (`open.er-api.com`) `"https://open.er-api.com/v6/latest/USD"` (`stateMap: { "cny": "$.rates.CNY", "eur": "$.rates.EUR", "jpy": "$.rates.JPY", "gbp": "$.rates.GBP" }`); CoinGecko Crypto `"https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin,ethereum,solana&vs_currencies=usd,cny&include_24hr_change=true"` (`stateMap: { "btcUsd": "$.bitcoin.usd", "btcChange": "$.bitcoin.usd_24h_change", "ethUsd": "$.ethereum.usd" }`).
- Runtime auto-sets `state.sourceStatus` (`"ok"`|`"loading"`|`"error"`), `state.sourceError`, `state.sourceUpdatedAt`. Trigger manual refresh via `{ "type": "source.refresh", "targetId": "<sourceId>" }` (alias `"sourceId"`; omit ID to refresh all sources) on an inline filter/status row (do NOT build a duplicate top widget title bar).

members.name: Tabs
members.descriptionZh: `bind: "state.tab"`, 按选中页签展示对应 `children`，避免单页过高

members.name: Image

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Use `Tabs` whenever a widget combines 3+ functional panels so initial height stays compact and scannable: declare `"main_tabs": { "type": "Tabs", "bind": "state.activeTab", "children": ["tab_sys", "tab_media"] }` in root `"elements"`, with each tab panel as a flat element like `"tab_sys": { "type": "Stack", "title": "系统", "value": "sys", "icon": "line-chart", "children": ["..."] }` and `"tab_media": { "type": "Stack", "title": "媒体", "value": "media", "icon": "music", "children": ["..."] }` (declare `"activeTab": "sys"` in root `"state"`).
- `Image`: `{ "type": "Image", "src": "${$device.mediaCover}", "width": 44, "height": 44, "stretch": "uniformToFill", "cornerRadius": 8 }` (`stretch`: `"uniform"` | `"uniformToFill"` | `"fill"`).
- `RingGauge` & `RadialGauge`: `RingGauge` (`progress`, `max`, `title`, `subtitle`, `unit`, `size`, `color`) or `RadialGauge` (`bind`/`progress`/`value`, `min`, `max`, `startAngle`, `sweepAngle`, `showTicks` + `tickStep`, `unit`, `animateChange`, `isInteractive` + `onChange` for drag-to-set).
- `BarList`: `{ "type": "BarList", "items": "items", "titleField": "title", "valueField": "value", "subtitleField": "sub", "unit": "%", "maxItems": 6, "color": "cyan" }`.

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Do NOT construct a 42-cell calendar manually from raw `Grid`/`Stack` nodes; always use `{ "type": "CalendarGrid", "bind": "state.selectedDate", "collection": "events", "dateField": "date" }`.
- Clicking a day updates `state.selectedDate` (`"yyyy-MM-dd"`), and `CalendarGrid` includes built-in month navigation and Lunar/Festival subtitles.
- Pair `CalendarGrid` with a filtered `List` (`"items": "events", "filter": "${state.selectedDate == '' || $item.date == state.selectedDate}"`) and an inline `Input` row below for a complete schedule widget.

members.descriptionEn: Opens native single/multi-file or folder picker and chains `then` or `onComplete(ctx, res)`

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Render `{ "type": "DropZone", "icon": "download", "title": "拖入文件或点击选择", "subtitle": "支持批量拖入", "format": ".png,.jpg", "onDrop": [ ...actions... ] }` for file queues, converters, or shelf workflows.
- Declarative `onDrop` actions read `${$drop.name}`, `${$drop.path}`, `${$drop.ext}`, `${$drop.sizeText}`, `${$drop.sizeBytes}`, `${$drop.count}`, `${$drop.text}`; when `onDrop` invokes `script.run`, `logic.js` receives the entire dropped batch in one call via `ctx.event.files` (`[{ name, path, ext, sizeBytes, sizeText, modifiedIso }]`).

  2. Live two-way hardware control (NO extra submit button): `{ "type": "Slider", "title": "主音量", "value": "${$device.volume}", "min": 0, "max": 100, "step": 2, "unit": "%", "onChange": { "type": "system.control", "targetId": "volume.set", "value": "${$value}" } }`.

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Always declare root `"collections": { "items": { "maxItems": 200, "sort": "newestFirst" } }`.
- `List`: `{ "type": "List", "items": "items", "filter": "${state.tab == 'all' || $item.done != true}", "emptyState": { "icon": "check", "title": "暂无记录" }, "itemTemplate": "item_row", "hoverActions": ["item_delete_btn"] }` where `"item_row"` and `"item_delete_btn": { "type": "IconButton", "icon": "delete", "size": 24, "variant": "danger", "onClick": { "type": "collection.remove", "collection": "items", "targetId": "${$item.id}" } }` are flat elements in root `"elements"`.
- Item tokens: `${$item.id}`, `${$item.rank}`, `${$item.index}`, `${$item.timeText}`, `${$item.dateText}`, `${$item.isToday}`. Summary tokens: `${collections.items.count}`, `${collections.items.todayCount}`, `${collections.items.latest.<field>}`.
- Drag-Reorder & Double-Click Inline Edit on `List`: set `"allowReorder": true` (optional `"onReorder"`) so users can drag-sort items natively, and set `"inlineEditField": "text"` (optional `"onInlineCommit"`) so double-clicking a row edits that field inline.

members.descriptionEn: Single-line preview, content type label, char length, line count, and clipboard bitmap flag

members.descriptionZh: 一键捕获剪贴板位图（兼容系统截图/微信/QQ DIB）保存为本地 PNG 并返回路径（需本地文件权限）
members.descriptionEn: Captures clipboard bitmap/DIB to a local PNG file and returns `{ path, name, width, height, sizeBytes }` (`LocalFileAccess`)

members.descriptionZh: 转换文本并写入 `state.<key>`；`mode: "copy"` 可同步复制结果
members.descriptionEn: Transforms text in-memory into `state.<key>` with optional clipboard copy

members.name: jsonPretty / jsonMinify / urlEncode / base64Encode / timestampToDate / uuid / sha256
members.descriptionZh: 内置 25 种免联网文本转换算子（含对应解码、大小写、字数统计与 MD5）
members.descriptionEn: 25 built-in deterministic text transform formats

members.name: jwtDecode / unicodeEscape / unicodeUnescape / jsonEscape / jsonUnescape / uuidNoDash / jsonPretty4 / dateToTimestampMs
members.descriptionZh: JWT 离线解码（含 exp/nbf 过期诊断与 `${$transform.jwtState}`）、中文 Unicode 转义往返、JSON 字符串转义与无横线 UUID
members.descriptionEn: Offline JWT decode with exp/nbf diagnostics (`${$transform.jwtState}`), CJK Unicode escape round-trips, JSON string escapes, and no-dash UUIDs

members.name: ${jwtdecode($clipboard.text)} / ${unicodeunescape(state.draft)} / ${uuid('upper')}
members.descriptionZh: 以上算子亦可直接在字符串插值表达式中调用（零联网、零反射）；失败时返回空字符串
members.descriptionEn: The same operators are callable inline inside string interpolation expressions (offline, zero-reflection); failures return an empty string

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Optional `"sources": [{ "type": "clipboard", "intervalMs": 2000 }]` exposes `${$clipboard.text}`, `${$clipboard.preview}`, `${$clipboard.length}`, `${$clipboard.lines}`, `${$clipboard.kind}` (`"json"`|`"jwt"`|`"unicodeEscape"`|`"url"`|`"urlEncoded"`|`"base64"`|`"timestamp"`|`"hexColor"`|`"number"`|`"text"`|`"image"`|`"empty"`), `${$clipboard.kindLabel}`, `${$clipboard.hasText}`, `${$clipboard.hasImage}`.
- Action `clipboard.captureImage`: `{ "type": "clipboard.captureImage", "path": "${$settings.saveDir}", "key": "lastImagePath", "onComplete": "onImageCaptured" }` saves the current clipboard bitmap/screenshot as PNG (`path` defaults to widget `files/` when omitted) and passes `res.data = { path, name, width, height, sizeBytes, sizeText }` to `onComplete` (`LocalFileAccess`).
- Action `text.transform`:
  `{ "type": "text.transform", "format": "jsonPretty", "text": "${state.rawText}", "key": "resultText", "mode": "copy" }`
  - If `"text"` is omitted and `clipboard` source is active, transforms current clipboard text directly.
  - Writes output to `state.<key>` (plus `state.transformOutput` and `${$transform.resultText}`); `"mode": "copy"` also copies the result to the system clipboard.
  - Supported `format` operations: `"jsonPretty"`, `"jsonPretty4"`, `"jsonMinify"`, `"jsonEscape"`, `"jsonUnescape"`, `"urlEncode"`, `"urlDecode"`, `"base64Encode"`, `"base64Decode"`, `"jwtDecode"`, `"unicodeEscape"`, `"unicodeUnescape"`, `"timestampToDate"`, `"dateToTimestamp"`, `"dateToTimestampMs"`, `"uuid"`, `"uuidNoDash"` (plus case variants `"uuidUpper"` / `"uuidNoDashUpper"`), `"upper"`, `"lower"`, `"trim"`, `"wordCount"`, `"sha256"`, `"md5"`.
  - `jwtDecode` is offline Base64Url decode only (signature is NOT verified); it prepends an exp/nbf status line and sets `${$transform.jwtState}` to `"valid"`, `"expired"`, `"noexp"`, or `"invalid"` after the action.
  - Every operator above is also callable directly inside expressions: `${jwtdecode($clipboard.text)}`, `${unicodeunescape('\u4e2d\u6587')}`, `${uuid()}`, `${timestamptodate(1700000000)}`.

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Use `{ "type": "launcher.open", "targetId": "<target>" }` (or `"path"` / `"url"`) for quick-launch docks and workspace hubs:
  - Known folders: `"downloads"`, `"desktop"`, `"documents"`, `"pictures"`, `"music"`, `"videos"`, `"userprofile"`.
  - Built-in Windows utilities: `"ms-screenclip:"` (screen snip), `"ms-calculator:"`, `"ms-clock:"`, `"ms-paint:"`, `"ms-todo:"`.
  - Developer & knowledge URIs: `"vscode://file/..."`, `"cursor://..."`, `"obsidian://open"`, `"notion://..."`, `"https://..."`.
  - Local paths: existing file or folder path (never executes arbitrary shell/cmd scripts).

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Pair `DropZone` with `{ "type": "file.transform", "path": "${$drop.path}", "format": "${state.format}", "value": "${state.maxWidth}", "then": [ ... ] }`.
- Supported `format` values ONLY:
  - Images (WinRT WIC native): `"png"`, `"jpg"`, `"bmp"`, `"tiff"`, `"ico"` (optional `"value"` max width px e.g. `"1024"`). Note: `"webp"` output is NOT supported because Windows WIC has no built-in WebP encoder.
  - Data/Checksum: `"csvToJson"`, `"jsonToCsv"`, `"jsonPretty"`, `"jsonMinify"`, `"mdToHtml"`, `"mdToTxt"`, `"base64Encode"`, `"base64Decode"`, `"sha256"`, `"md5"`.
  - Video/Audio/Office/PDF transcoding is NOT supported in the sandbox.
- Inside `"then"`, read `${$transform.outputName}`, `${$transform.outputPath}`, `${$transform.sizeText}`, `${$transform.resultText}`.

capabilities.summaryZh: 在离线 QuickJS 沙箱中运行私有 ES2023 脚本（logic.js），实现自定义算法、复杂状态机与 API 数据清洗。
capabilities.summaryEn: Runs an isolated offline ES2023 module (logic.js) in QuickJS for custom algorithms, state machines, and API payload parsing.

members.name: script: { "entry": "logic.js", "tickIntervalMs": 0 }
members.descriptionZh: 声明启用私有 QuickJS 计算脚本模块及可选定时节拍（>= 1000ms，窗口隐藏自动休眠）
members.descriptionEn: Declares the isolated QuickJS ES2023 script entry and optional tick interval (>= 1000ms, auto-hibernates when hidden)

members.name: { "type": "script.run", "fn": "step", "arg": "1", "args": { ... } }
members.descriptionZh: 调用 logic.js 导出的同步纯计算函数，支持结构化 `ctx.args`、`ctx.event` 与 `ctx.dispatch`
members.descriptionEn: Invokes an exported synchronous function in logic.js with `ctx.args`, `ctx.event`, and `ctx.dispatch`

members.name: ctx.state (structured JSON) & ${$computed.<key>}
members.descriptionZh: `ctx.state` 原生支持结构化 JSON（布尔/数值/字符串/数组/对象）直接持久化落盘；`${$computed.<key>}` 存瞬态派生视图
members.descriptionEn: `ctx.state` natively persists structured JSON (`boolean`, `number`, `string`, `array`, `object`); `${$computed.<key>}` holds ephemeral projections

members.name: onInit(ctx) | onSourceData(ctx, id, raw) | onTick(ctx, nowMs) | onComplete(ctx, res) | onProgress(ctx, p)
members.descriptionZh: 生命周期与统一异步作业回调（支持 `job.cancel` 随时取消后台任务）
members.descriptionEn: Lifecycle hooks and unified async job progress/result callbacks with `job.cancel`

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Optional sidecar `logic.js` runs inside an offline QuickJS ES2023 sandbox (no network/DOM/filesystem, <= 50 ms CPU, <= 4 MB RAM, zero idle memory).
- Declare `"script": { "entry": "logic.js", "tickIntervalMs": 0 }` in `manifest.json` (`tickIntervalMs` is `0` or `1000..3600000`, auto-paused when widget is hidden).
- `ctx` provides:
  - `ctx.state`: structured JSON map (`boolean`, `number`, `string`, `array`, `object`) persisted natively in `store.json` without `JSON.stringify`! Mutate arrays/objects directly (e.g. `ctx.state.jobs.push(...)`) and bind via `${state.jobs.length}`, `${state.jobs[0].name}`, or `"items": "${state.jobs}"` on `List`/`Table`/`Chart`/`BarList`.
  - `ctx.collections` (persisted record arrays), `ctx.settings` (read-only), `ctx.computed` (ephemeral scalar/array map read via `${$computed.<key>}`), `ctx.locale`, `ctx.nowIso`, and `ctx.t(key, ...args)`.
  - `ctx.env.sys`: live host telemetry (`cpuPercent`, `memoryPercent`, `memoryUsedGb`, `memoryTotalGb`, `memorySummary`, `gpuPercent`, `gpuName`, `gpuVramSummary`, `diskPercent`, `diskSummary`, `netDown`, `netUp`, `batteryPercent`, `batteryStatus`, `uptime`).
  - `ctx.env.device`: live host device state (`volume`, `isMuted`, `audioDeviceName`, `brightness`, `wifiEnabled`, `wifiStatus`, `bluetoothEnabled`, `bluetoothStatus`, `networkConnected`, `keepAwake`, `batteryPercent`, `isCharging`). **Note**: `ctx.sources` does NOT exist — always read telemetry from `ctx.env.sys` / `ctx.env.device`.
- Always export `onInit(ctx)` to populate initial `ctx.computed.*` values so cold start never shows blank placeholders; optionally export `onSourceData(ctx, sourceId, rawText)` and `onTick(ctx, nowUnixMs)`.
- Structured `args`, UI `ctx.event`, & Async Job Dispatch: pass `"args": { "row": 1 }` on `script.run` -> `ctx.args`; UI & drop handlers populate `ctx.event` (`{ id, x, y, value, fromIndex, toIndex, files: [{ name, path, ext, sizeBytes, sizeText, modifiedIso }] }`); call `ctx.dispatch(actionOrArray)` (up to 16 actions) to queue host actions. Async actions (`command.run`, `http.request`, `ai.run`, `file.pick`, `file.listDir`, `file.manage`, `file.transform`, `clipboard.captureImage`) invoke `onComplete` (or `onCommandResult` / `onHttpResponse`) with unified `res = { id, jobKey, type, ok, status, text, data, error, timedOut, cancelled, durationMs, meta }`; cancel running jobs via `{ "type": "job.cancel", "jobKey": "<keyOr*>" }`.

members.descriptionEn: Supports `fill`, `stroke`, `strokeWidth`, `opacity`, `rotation`, SVG `d` path commands, and text alignment

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Render custom clocks, gauges, mini-games, radar/spider charts, or interactive scrubbers natively with `"type": "Canvas"` (`width`, `height`, `viewBox`: `"0 0 200 200"`).
- Bind static `"elements": [...]` OR dynamic `"elementsSource": "${$computed.shapes}"` (in `logic.js`, assign `ctx.computed.shapes = [{ id: 'cell-0', kind: 'rect', x: 10, y: 10, width: 40, height: 40, rx: 6, fill: '#3B82F6' }, ...]`).
- Supported shape `kind`s (all shapes also support `linearGradient`, `radialGradient`, `strokeCap`: `flat|round|square`):
  - `rect`: `x`, `y`, `width`, `height`, `rx`, `ry`, `fill`, `stroke`, `strokeWidth`, `rotation`
  - `circle`: `cx`, `cy`, `r`, `fill`, `stroke`, `strokeWidth`
  - `ellipse`: `cx`, `cy`, `rx`, `ry`, `fill`, `stroke`, `strokeWidth`
  - `arc`: `cx`, `cy`, `r`, `startAngle`, `sweepAngle`, `fill`, `stroke`, `strokeWidth`, `strokeCap`
  - `line`: `x1`, `y1`, `x2`, `y2`, `stroke`, `strokeWidth`, `rotation`, `cx`, `cy`
  - `polyline` / `polygon`: `points` (`"10,90 50,40 90,65"`), `fill`, `stroke`, `strokeWidth`
  - `path`: `d` (SVG path commands `M/L/H/V/C/Q/Z`), `fill`, `stroke`, `strokeWidth`
  - `text`: `x`, `y`, `text`, `fontSize`, `fontWeight`, `fill`, `textAnchor` (`start|middle|end`)
- Interactive hit-testing & continuous pointer gestures: set `"id"` on clickable shapes with `"onItemClick"` (`{ id, x, y }`), or wire `"onPointerDown"` / `"onPointerMove"` / `"onPointerUp"` receiving `{ x, y, normX, normY, isPressed }` in `ctx.event` / `${$event.normX}`!
- Dedup KPIs: When drawing a central hero number/percentage inside a `Canvas` donut/ring, do NOT repeat the exact same primary value or percentage as adjacent `Text`/`Badge` nodes in the enclosing `Card` header.

members.descriptionEn: Watch/write UTF-8 files, scan directories (`file.listDir`), or copy/move/rename/recycle files via OS Recycle Bin (`LocalFileAccess`)

members.descriptionEn: Runs local CLI processes with optional `longRunning: true` idle-stall watchdog, `4Hz` `onProgress` streaming, unified `res` callback, and `job.cancel` (`CommandExecution`)

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Local File I/O & Directory Operations (`LocalFileAccess` permission):
  - Watch/Write UTF-8 file: `{ "id": "noteFile", "type": "fileText", "path": "${$settings.filePath}", "stateKey": "fileBody", "intervalMs": 5000 }` and `{ "type": "file.writeText", "path": "${$settings.filePath}", "text": "${state.fileBody}", "append": false }`.
  - Declarative folder source (ideal for photo/video galleries, media walls, and watched folders): `{ "id": "albumDir", "type": "localFolder", "path": "${$settings.folderPath}", "targetCollection": "slides", "extensions": ["image/*", "video/*"], "sort": "modifiedDesc", "recursive": false, "maxItems": 100 }` (`sort` accepts `modifiedDesc`|`modifiedAsc`|`nameAsc`|`nameDesc`|`sizeDesc`|`sizeAsc`, including expressions; `path` accepts full paths, `~/...`, `%USERPROFILE%\\...`, or known folders `Downloads`, `Desktop`, `Documents`, `Pictures`, `Music`, `Videos`; auto-watches directory changes and populates `slides` with `{ id, title, name, path, ext, kind ("image"|"video"|"audio"|"file"), isVideo, isImage, sizeBytes, sizeText, modifiedIso }`). Multi-line `text` media/path settings also auto-expand folder lines in `ctx.settings`.
  - Imperative directory scan: `{ "type": "file.listDir", "path": "${$settings.watchDir}", "pattern": "*.mp4;*.mov", "recursive": false, "maxItems": 200, "targetCollection": "files", "onComplete": "onDirListed" }` (`res.data` is `[{ name, path, ext, sizeBytes, sizeText, modifiedIso, isDirectory }]`).
  - Manage files safely: `{ "type": "file.manage", "op": "copy|move|rename|recycle", "path": "${$item.path}", "destination": "...", "onComplete": "onFileManaged" }` (`recycle` moves to Windows Recycle Bin; permanent deletion is strictly forbidden).
- Local CLI Command & Async Job Bus (`CommandExecution` permission, Direct distribution):
  - Polling source: `{ "id": "gitProbe", "type": "command", "executable": "git", "arguments": ["status", "--short"], "workingDirectory": "${$settings.repoDir}", "stateKey": "gitOut", "intervalMs": 15000 }`.
  - Interactive / Long-running CLI job: `{ "type": "command.run", "id": "encode", "jobKey": "ffmpeg-1", "executable": "${$settings.ffmpegPath}", "arguments": ["-y", "-i", "...", "-progress", "pipe:1", "..."], "longRunning": true, "onProgress": "onEncodeProgress", "onComplete": "onEncodeDone" }`.
  - Default short timeout is `30000` ms (`30s`); setting `"longRunning": true` (or `"timeoutMs": 0`) removes the fixed wall-clock cap and uses a **3-minute (`180s`) output-silence watchdog** while keeping jobs alive even when collapsed to a desktop capsule!
  - `onProgress(ctx, p)` receives `{ id, jobKey, type: 'command.run', line, text, stream, elapsedMs }` (throttled `4Hz`); `onComplete(ctx, res)` (or `onCommandResult(ctx, res)`) receives unified `{ id, jobKey, type: 'command.run', ok, status, text, data: { exitCode, stdout, stderr }, error, timedOut, cancelled, durationMs, meta }`. Cancel anytime via `{ "type": "job.cancel", "jobKey": "ffmpeg-1" }` (or `"*"` to cancel all).

members.descriptionEn: Notification badge, inline alert bar, anchored callout tip, multi-span rich text, copyable code block, and arc gauge

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
- Host-Managed Window Chrome & Full-Bleed Stage: DeskBox unifies title-bar mode (Standard / Compact / Overlay), corner radius, material, and dragging via user settings — NEVER emit a root `"chrome"` key or custom drag bar! Use `"padding": "0"` on a root `ZStack` or `Grid` (`"rows": "*,Auto"`) for full-bleed album art, photo/video walls, clocks, or ambient HUDs, and never stack fixed-height children in a root vertical `Stack` exceeding `defaultSize.height`.
- `radialGradient` on Canvas vector shapes (`fill`): `{ "centerX": 0.5, "centerY": 0.3, "radiusX": 0.7, "radiusY": 0.7, "stops": [{ "offset": 0, "color": "#38BDF8" }, { "offset": 1, "color": "#0F172A" }] }` (layout containers inherit DeskBox's host glass backdrop instead of opaque gradients).
- Layout & Navigation:
  - `ZStack`: overlays `children` in z-order (use `horizontalAlignment`/`verticalAlignment`/`margin` on children).
  - `ItemsGrid`: `{ "type": "ItemsGrid", "items": "photos", "minItemWidth": 96, "spacing": 8, "itemTemplate": "photo_tile" }` (referencing element `"photo_tile"` in root `"elements"`). `minItemWidth` (alias `minColumnWidth`, default 108, clamped 36..420) is the responsive column floor; `columnsCount` (alias `columns`, clamped 1..16) pins a fixed column count instead. Without `items`/`collection` the `children` are laid out directly.
  - `SelectorBar`: `{ "type": "SelectorBar", "bind": "state.section", "options": [{ "value": "all", "label": "All", "icon": "grid" }] }` (or `children` panels).
  - `FlipView`: `{ "type": "FlipView", "items": "slides", "bind": "state.slideIndex", "height": 180, "itemTemplate": "slide_card" }` (referencing element `"slide_card"` in root `"elements"`, or static `children` IDs).
  - `SplitView`: `{ "type": "SplitView", "bind": "state.paneOpen", "paneWidth": 140, "displayMode": "compactInline", "pane": "nav_pane", "children": ["main_content"] }` (referencing flat element IDs in root `"elements"`). With 2+ `children` IDs and no explicit `pane`, `children[0]` becomes the pane and the remaining children the content; an explicit `"pane": "<paneId>"` element reference always wins and leaves ALL `children` in the content. `displayMode`: `compactInline` (default) | `inline` | `overlay` | `compactOverlay`; also `panePlacement` (`left|right`), `compactPaneWidth`, `isOpen`, `defaultExpanded`.
- Menus, Feedback, Typography & Gauge:
  - `SplitButton` / `DropDownButton`: `{ "type": "SplitButton", "text": "Run", "variant": "accent", "onClick": { ... }, "menuItems": [{ "text": "Fast Mode", "icon": "sparkles", "onClick": { ... } }, { "separator": true }] }`. On any NON-button node, `"menuItems": [...]` — or the canonical `"contextMenu": [...]` — attaches a native right-click MenuFlyout (`contextMenu` wins when both are present; entries take `label`/`text`, `icon`, `value`, `onClick`, `when`, `separator: true`, and nested `children` for submenus). `SplitButton`/`DropDownButton` reserve `menuItems` for their own flyout, so use `contextMenu` on those two for right-click.
  - `InfoBadge`: `{ "type": "InfoBadge", "value": "${state.unread}", "tone": "accent" }` (dot mode when `value` omitted).
  - `InfoBar`: `{ "type": "InfoBar", "severity": "informational|success|warning|error", "title": "Ready", "subtitle": "...", "isClosable": true }`.
  - `TeachingTip`: `{ "type": "TeachingTip", "id": "helpTip", "target": "runBtn", "title": "Tip", "subtitle": "..." }` controlled via `tip.open|close|toggle` (`targetId`: `"helpTip"`).
  - `RichText`: `{ "type": "RichText", "spans": [{ "text": "$128", "fontSize": 24, "fontWeight": "bold", "color": "accent" }, { "text": " / mo", "color": "secondary" }] }`. A span with `"href": "https://..."` renders as a clickable link dispatched as the `url.open` action (http/https only, gated by the `PublicNetwork` permission); a span `"onClick": { ... }` runs custom actions instead. Spans also accept `underline`, `italic`, `strikethrough`, `monospace`, `fontFamily`.
  - `CodeBlock`: `{ "type": "CodeBlock", "bind": "state.log", "language": "bash", "copyable": true, "wrapText": false, "autoScrollTail": true, "maxHeight": 180 }`. The body comes from `bind` while the bound value is non-empty, otherwise from `text` (aliases `code`/`markdown`); `autoScrollTail` (alias `followTail`, default false) re-pins the scroll view to the newest line on every change, `copyable` (alias `showCopyButton`, default true) toggles the copy button, and `wrapText: false` enables horizontal scrolling.
  - `RadialGauge`: `{ "type": "RadialGauge", "bind": "state.level", "min": 0, "max": 100, "startAngle": -140, "sweepAngle": 280, "showTicks": true, "tickStep": 10, "unit": "%", "animateChange": true, "isInteractive": true, "onChange": { "type": "state.set", "key": "state.level", "value": "${$value}" } }`. The dial value resolves from `bind` first, then `progress`, then `value` (all interpolated, so `"bind": "state.speed"` alone is enough — no `value` required). Also `title`, `subtitle`, `text` (center label override), `size` (56..260), `thickness`, `color`, `warningThreshold`/`dangerThreshold`, `linearGradient`, and `style: "full"` for a closed ring. `tickStep` is a step in VALUE units and only draws when `showTicks: true` (`min:0, max:100, tickStep:10` gives 10 intervals); without `tickStep` the dial uses 12 intervals. `animateChange: true` is a 150ms opacity change-highlight pulse on the center value when it changes — it is NOT a numeric tween. `isInteractive: true` makes the dial pointer-draggable (requires `bind` or `onChange`): dragging writes the bound state live and fires `onChange` with `${$value}` on release.

capabilities.compactContractMarkdown:
